audience: home service business owners and dispatchers who run jobs and estimates in Housecall Pro

useCases.title: See this week's jobs and who they are dispatched to
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs in a scheduled window with customer, address, schedule and assigned employees. You can also filter by work status or employee.

useCases.title: Find open and overdue invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by status, customer and due or paid dates, with amounts. You see which are unpaid and how old they are.

useCases.title: Review estimates and which options were approved
useCases.text: The AI lists estimates and reads one with its options and the approval status of each option.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by name, email, mobile number or address, and reads their addresses. It can create a customer or change contact details and tags.

useCases.title: Create a job or an estimate for a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates a job or an estimate for an existing customer address, with line items priced in cents. A job can also be scheduled and assigned.

useCases.title: Reschedule or dispatch a job, or add a note
useCases.text: The AI changes a job's start, end and arrival window, sets which employees are dispatched, or adds a text note to the job.
